topics.justification: Dominated by Java-centric implementation terms (class, method, provider, instance) plus error/exception/fix, suggesting questions about using JCA/JCE classes and resolving runtime/API misuse issues.

Strong presence of library/openssl along with version, build, include, module, package, dependency, indicating issues around linking/wrapping OpenSSL or adding crypto libraries to projects and managing build configuration.
Keywords center on key material in files (public_key, private_key, certificate), reading/importing/converting formats, and OpenSSL, typical of PEM/DER/PKCS#8/CSR handling for client/server use.

topics.topic_name: Hash algorithm choice and secure implementations
topics.justification: Implementation, hash, algorithm, security, standard, recommend, safe/break/choose point to discussions about selecting hash algorithms and evaluating security properties and defaults.

Run/compile/compiler/tool/test/bug/source_code suggest practical software engineering concerns: reproducing issues, compiling code, tooling, and debugging crypto implementations rather than cryptographic primitives themselves.
High weights for understand, simple, suggest, start, search, documentation/read imply beginner-oriented questions asking how to approach or interpret encryption code and where to find guidance.

Key/encrypt/decrypt/password/salt/mode/padding/byte/bit/block/size strongly indicate symmetric encryption usage details, especially deriving/using keys from passwords and dealing with ciphertext encoding and parameters.
